## About Booklover

Booklover is Bangladesh's most trusted online shop for premium bean bags and lifestyle furniture. We use high-density beans and premium fabric across every product, backed by a published refund policy and fast home delivery.

## What we sell

- **Bean bags**: Classic bean bags, XXL bean bags, round & teardrop shapes
- **Bean bag sofas**: 2-seater and 3-seater bean bag sofas for living rooms
- **Lounge chairs**: Indoor and outdoor lounge chairs
- **Kids bean bags**: Compact, safe bean bags for children
- **Cushions**: Floor cushions, throw cushions, back support cushions
- **Ottomans**: Footrest ottomans and storage ottomans

## Why customers choose us

- Premium fabric and high-density filling for lasting comfort
- Fast delivery across Bangladesh
- Local payment methods: bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Bank Transfer (DBBL), Cash on Delivery, wallet credit
- Real-time order tracking inside customer dashboard
- Customer support over WhatsApp, live chat, and ticket system
- Refund eligible for 1–7 days per published refund policy
- 1,000+ verified customer reviews; Facebook-verified store
- PWA (installable mobile app) — works offline, push notifications

## Payment & delivery

- **Payment methods**: bKash (online tokenized + manual), Nagad, Rocket, Bank Transfer (DBBL), Cash on Delivery, wallet balance
- **Standard delivery window**: 2–5 business days depending on location within Bangladesh
- Order updates and tracking are sent to the customer's account dashboard and email

## Refund & return policy

- Refund requests accepted within 1–7 days of purchase
- A 10% processing charge applies to approved refunds
- Products that have been used or damaged are not eligible for refund
- Refund requests can be submitted at /refund-request after login
- Replacement provided if the delivered product is defective, verified by support
